summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py, placed after print. It joins str(obj) for each object with sep and calls self.print once with emoji, markup, and crop off, no_wrap on, overflow set to "ignore", and the given style, highlight (default True), and end passed through. Added a CHANGELOG entry "Added Console.out" under 9.0.0 Added, and a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after the logging section. Added tests in tests/test_console.py: test_out (separator, end, no-wrap at width 10), plus tests for no objects, return value, literal markup and emoji, no pretty printing, style, highlight True/False/None, and a render hook. RenderHook was added to the existing rich.console import. Tests were not run, per instructions, so they are unverified. The highlight tests assert only the presence of the "\x1b[" prefix, not exact escape bytes. No commits were made.
